name: SOC-008: Windows Discovery Activity Detected
description: Detects reconnaissance and discovery activity on Windows including network scanning, user/group enumeration, and system information gathering.
aql_expression: SELECT QIDNAME(qid) as EventName, sourceIP, destinationIP, username, LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) as LogSource, payload, starttime FROM events WHERE LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) ILIKE '%Windows%' AND (payload ILIKE '%net user%' OR payload ILIKE '%net group%' OR payload ILIKE '%net localgroup%' OR payload ILIKE '%systeminfo%' OR payload ILIKE '%ipconfig%/all%' OR payload ILIKE '%nltest%' OR payload ILIKE '%whoami%/all%') ORDER BY starttime DESC LAST 300 SECONDS
